summary: Wide gravel angle-parking apron backed by dense bush beside Witton Road.
reasons: Gravel apron, room to pull fully off

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind; nearest dwelling 32 m and the canoe club 19 m, which is non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide bare gravel apron meets the road edge; room for a van clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moderately busy road beside the apron; the van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P Angle; cars park along the road here.

flags: Low-lying: 2.5 to 8 m elevation, Witton Creek 19 m away, flood-prone
Slope about 1% on the best section; it falls steeply past 30 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the apron from the north and west; open from the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the 4P limit is enforced overnight

best_section.where: Gravel apron on the north side of Witton Road, east of the bend by the bridge
